item.title: Ask : The counterintuitive online formula to discover exactly what your customers want to buy...create a mass of raving fans...and take any business to the next level
item.description:
Overview of “Ask” by Ryan Levesque

Summary

“Ask: The Counterintuitive Online Formula to Discover Exactly What Your Customers Want to Buy…Create a Mass of Raving Fans…and Take Any Business to the Next Level” by Ryan Levesque introduces a unique approach to understanding customer needs through a process he calls the “Ask Method.” This strategy emphasizes structured customer surveys to gain deep insights into market desires, enabling businesses to tailor their offerings effectively. Levesque outlines a step-by-step process for deploying this method and shares how it has helped various businesses enhance their marketing efforts, engage customers, and increase sales.

item.title: Choose: The Single Most Important Decision Before Starting Your Business
item.description:
Overview of Choose: The Single Most Important Decision Before Starting Your Business by Ryan Levesque

Summary

Choose by Ryan Levesque is a business guide aimed at entrepreneurs considering starting a new business. The book focuses on the importance of making the right initial decision regarding what market to enter, emphasizing that this choice can significantly influence the success or failure of a business. Levesque uses his own experiences and case studies to illustrate the impact of choosing the correct market and niche. The book provides a framework to assist readers in evaluating potential markets, avoiding common pitfalls, and building a sustainable and profitable business right from the start.
